# Develop Minnesota

> A comprehensive early childhood education training and resource platform connecting Minnesota educators with professional development opportunities, trainer networks, and competency-based learning.

Develop Minnesota is the official portal for early childhood education trainers, courses, and professional development across Minnesota. It serves as a centralized hub for accessing training resources, connecting with qualified trainers, and maintaining compliance with state education requirements.

## Key Topics

- Early Childhood Education
- Trainer Directory
- Professional Development
- Training Requirements
- Competency Framework
- Minnesota Department of Education
- Child Care Aware
- Trauma Informed Care
- CPR/First Aid
- American Sign Language
- Data Privacy Agreement
- Trainer Qualifications
- Minnesota Counties
- RBPD Specialists
- Multilingual Training

## Trainer Resources

- [Trainer Directory](https://app.developtoolmn.org/TrainerDirectory.aspx): Searchable directory of early childhood education trainers across Minnesota with filtering by location, specialization, and qualifications.

## Training Courses & Events

- [Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) Training](https://app.developtoolmn.org/EventDetail.aspx?ESID=3&ESEventID=225200): Self-paced SUID training course for early childhood staff with clock hours credit toward professional requirements.

## Data & Privacy

- [Data Privacy Agreement](https://app.developtoolmn.org/DataPrivacyAgreement.aspx?ReturnURL=/Reports.aspx): Data privacy agreement for Develop Minnesota covering sensitive data access terms and user authorization requirements.
